title: Memorial Health Annual Reports
evidenceUse: Annual-report context, community benefit reporting, system narrative, and public financial context.
limitations: Annual reports are system-level narrative/summary sources and do not by themselves prove Taylorville-only margin or claim-level payment.

title: Memorial Health System Form 990
evidenceUse: IRS Form 990 revenue, expenses, net income, net assets, compensation, Schedule H, and related-organization context.
limitations: Form 990 is a tax/public-inspection filing and may not match audited-GAAP presentation; it is system/legal-entity evidence, not a facility cost report.

title: HSHS 2024 Annual Report
evidenceUse: System narrative, community benefit, service footprint, and annual operating context.
limitations: Annual report context should be validated against Form 990, audited statements, cost reports, and bond disclosures before drawing finance conclusions.

title: HSHS FY2024 Consolidated Financial Statements and Single Audit
publisher: Federal Audit Clearinghouse / ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
evidenceUse: Consolidated audited operating result, balance sheet, liquidity, debt, and federal/state award audit context.
limitations: This is consolidated HSHS system evidence. It does not prove margin, subsidy, or service-line profitability for any single Illinois hospital.

title: HSHS FY2025 Single Audit Source Page
publisher: Federal Audit Clearinghouse / ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
evidenceUse: Next audited-system extraction target after FY2024. Use for multi-year trend once downloaded and parsed.
limitations: Mapped as source availability only; numeric FY2025 audited statement fields are not extracted yet.

title: Hospital Sisters Health System Form 990
evidenceUse: IRS Form 990 legal-entity financial and governance evidence.
limitations: HSHS operates multiple hospitals and related entities; Form 990 figures need entity matching before facility-level interpretation.

title: MSRB EMMA Bond Disclosure Search
evidenceUse: Find official statements, continuing disclosures, ratings, debt service, covenants, and obligated-group disclosure documents.
limitations: Specific HSHS CUSIP/obligated-group documents are not extracted yet. The audit identifies long-term debt, but rating and covenant context still need EMMA/rating-agency validation.

title: Becker's HSHS FY2024 Financial Report Summary
evidenceUse: Secondary cross-check for FY2024 operating loss, revenue, expenses, cybersecurity cost, closures, and net loss narrative.
limitations: Secondary reporting should not replace the audited financial statement. Use it for context and cross-checks only.

title: OSF HealthCare Facts & Figures
evidenceUse: System scale, operating footprint, annual volumes, and financial overview context.
limitations: Facts-and-figures pages are summary evidence; use Form 990, audited statements, HCRIS, and HFS files for audit-grade reconciliation.

title: OSF Healthcare System Form 990
evidenceUse: IRS Form 990 financial, governance, compensation, and Schedule H context.
limitations: System Form 990 requires facility/entity crosswalk before comparing to individual OSF hospital HCRIS rows.

title: The Carle Foundation Hospital Form 990
evidenceUse: IRS Form 990 context for a major Carle legal entity.
limitations: This seed is tied to The Carle Foundation Hospital entity; Carle Health system-level consolidation and newer affiliates may require additional EINs and audited statements.

title: Northwestern Medicine Financial Statements and Annual Reports
latestPeriod: FY2025 financial statements and annual reports listed
evidenceUse: Consolidated Northwestern Memorial HealthCare financial statements, annual reports, and community benefit reporting.
limitations: Northwestern states the financial statements are consolidated and not updated after the document date; facility-level interpretation still needs CCN/cost-report matching.

title: Rush Bondholder Information
evidenceUse: Bondholder, obligated-group, audited-financial, and disclosure context.
limitations: Bondholder disclosures are investor materials and may not include every item needed for facility-level finance conclusions.

title: Rush University Medical Center Form 990
evidenceUse: IRS Form 990 revenue, expenses, net income, net assets, compensation, and Schedule H context.
limitations: RUSH system/obligated-group finance and medical-center tax filings must be kept distinct from facility cost-report fields.

title: Endeavor Health Form 990
evidenceUse: IRS Form 990 seed for Endeavor Health legal-entity financial context.
limitations: Endeavor was formed from NorthShore/Edward-Elmhurst entities; older years and hospital-specific entities may require additional EINs and audited statements.

title: Advocate Health Investor Relations
evidenceUse: Audited financial statements, quarterly disclosures, investor materials, and bond disclosure context.
limitations: Advocate Health is a large multi-state consolidated system; Illinois hospital analysis still needs facility-level cost reports and payer/payment files.

title: UChicago Medicine Financial Information
evidenceUse: Audited financial statements and selected financial information for UChicago Medicine.
limitations: Academic medical center finance may include system, university, faculty-practice, and hospital relationships that need careful entity matching.

title: University of Chicago Medical Center Form 990
evidenceUse: IRS Form 990 revenue, expenses, net income, net assets, compensation, and Schedule H context.
limitations: Form 990 should be reconciled to audited statements and HCRIS before making facility-specific finance arguments.

title: Rush FY2024 Annual Financial Report Audited
evidenceUse: Obligated-group audited operating result, liquidity, debt capacity, days cash, debt-service coverage, and bond-rating context.
limitations: Obligated-group evidence is system capacity evidence, not facility-level profitability for RUMC, Rush Oak Park, or Copley individually.

title: Northwestern Memorial HealthCare FY2025 Audited Financial Statements
evidenceUse: Consolidated audited balance sheet and operating statement fields for system capacity comparison.
limitations: Consolidated Northwestern Memorial HealthCare evidence should not be read as any single hospital's HCRIS result.

title: UChicago Medicine 2025 Audited Financial Statements
evidenceUse: Consolidated audited operating revenues, operating expenses, operating result, assets, liabilities, cash, investments, and debt.
limitations: Academic medical center finance can include hospital, network, affiliate, university, and physician relationships.

title: HSHS About Us System Profile
evidenceUse: System footprint, mission, governance, hospital count, physician partner, and colleague scale context.
limitations: Footprint facts do not prove liquidity, debt capacity, audited margin, or facility-specific subsidies.
